//: Browser identity profiles. A profile is a persistent Chrome profile dir a human logs into once; the agent only ever drives it. `hosts` picks a profile from the URLs in a task; `identities` are the names a caller may ask for. `pool: true` marks the anonymous scratch profiles — never log in there. Add a row per site you sign in to.

profiles.name: scratch
profiles.description: Anonymous disposable browsing; never log in here.
